id: HEARD AT THE AIRPORT [New York Times, Sunday, January 4, 1998]

metadata.title: HEARD AT THE AIRPORT [New York Times, Sunday, January 4, 1998]
metadata.author: Mark Danna

entries.clue: River name meaning "where the goods are brought in"
"Hey, babe, wanna sit with me on the plane?"
"While we're in the air, write an essay on aviation"
"I'm an unattractive woman who'll gab the whole trip"
"Follow orders in this plane area or else!"
"Prepare to do a spoof on airports"
"Executives, today's lesson is on jet financing"
"First I'll read, then watch the movie, then..."
Lions and tigers and bears, e.g.
"What's that knitter doing during air turbulence?"
